inj.note: Los Angeles placed Grupe on injured reserve earlier Monday and likely will work out multiple kickers over the next few days before deciding on a new option prior to Sunday's game against the Raiders. Signed off the Jets' practice squad last week, Grupe converted a 44-yard field goal in the first quarter of Sunday's contest before sustaining the season-ending injury while attempting to make a tackle on the ensuing kickoff return.

news.h: Sources: Rams signing free agent kicker Brandon McManus
news.d: The Rams, after releasing Harrison Mevis and an injury to Blake Grupe, are signing free agent kicker Brandon McManus, sources told NFL Network.

news.h: Rams place kicker Blake Grupe on IR due to knee injury
news.d: The Rams have placed kicker Blake Grupe on injured reserve after he injured his right knee in the team's Week 6 loss to the Cardinals.

news.h: Ethan Evans' heroics for Rams, after Blake Grupe was hurt, short-lived in loss
news.d: In his first game since replacing Harrison Mevis, Blake Grupe left because of a knee injury and didn't return. Punter Ethan Evans hit a go-ahead PAT late.

news.h: Why Rams releasing Harrison Mevis for Blake Grupe is a 'significant change'
news.d: Why Rams releasing Harrison Mevis for Blake Grupe is a 'significant change'

news.h: Rams releasing kicker Mevis after miscues in loss, sign Grupe from Jets
news.d: The Rams are releasing kicker Harrison Mevis and signing Blake Grupe off the Jets' practice squad, sources told NFL Network's Ian Rapoport and Mike Garafolo on Tuesday.
